intro: If your billable utilization is below target for consultants, you are likely losing thousands of dollars every year due to manual tracking errors. blocks.text: Why your billable utilization is below target

The gap between your actual hours and your billable target often stems from memory decay. You finish a long day of client calls, internal meetings, and research, but you do not log your time until Friday. By then, the nuances of your day are gone. Research suggests this delay causes consultants to lose nearly half of their billable time.
The hidden cost of manual tracking

Manual systems like Excel spreadsheets or paper logs are prone to human error. Studies show these methods have error rates between 15% and 25%. If you are a consultant at a 50-person firm, missing just one hour per person each week results in nearly $900,000 of lost revenue annually. This is not just a bookkeeping issue. It is a direct hit to your firm's bottom line.
Proven fixes for accurate time tracking

items: Use automated tracking software that runs in the background on your Mac.
Set a 30-minute block every Friday to reconcile your calendar and browser history.
Define clear categories for billable work to avoid misclassification.
Connect your time tracking tool directly to your invoicing system.

blocks.text: If you work in a regulated industry like law, accounting, or nursing, ensure your tracking practices comply with your employer's data privacy policies. Never store sensitive client or patient information in third-party time tracking tools.

blocks.text: How Lazur helps you track your time

Lazur cannot click buttons in your time tracker, but it can help you maintain the discipline needed to track your hours. Hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask Lazur to summarize your recent meetings or draft a status email. This keeps your records fresh and your billable entries accurate without the usual administrative friction.

faq.question: What is a good billable utilization target?
faq.answer: Most firms target between 70% and 85%. However, sustained utilization above 80% is often a signal of potential burnout.

faq.question: Does Lazur automatically track my time?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not track your app usage or log your hours. It helps you manage your communication and documentation so you can log your own time more efficiently.
